name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Kyton)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 219
Aura faint conjuration [evil, law] CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 7,300 gp; Weight —
Description
This iron ring has several sharp barbs. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, the wearer adds augurB3 to the 3rd-level list of monsters he can summon with those spells, adds sacristanB4 to the 7th-level list, and adds interlocutorB3 to the 9th-level list. Also, once per day on command the wearer can use this ring to summon an augur, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be lawful evil; Cost 3,650 gp
